classification: post-hoc execution-cost stress of the R334 robust candidate; no parameter or weight search
decision: Both 4x and 5x must pass; otherwise downgrade the R334 candidate to research_only_cost_fragile.
discipline: No lookback, target-vol, asset, cap, TopN or gate tuning.
Use actual engine backtests for 4x/5x stock costs and the same overlay/rebalance logic.
No paper target or order file.
fixed_strategy: R334 center: A/B Top10, 60d/15%, equity share capped at 1/3, gold/10Y treasury/dividend each 1/3 monthly

gates.5x: total return >0, Sharpe >=0.5, MDD >= -25%, 2022/2023 >=0, recent year >0
gates.concentration_5x: C1-C7 and C11-C12 still pass under 5x costs; asset contribution and weight gates unchanged

known_limitations: This tests historical execution costs, not live broker fill quality.
ETF qfq and industry-snapshot limitations remain.
